# Cygnix Labs

> SEO and AI-search (GEO/AEO) tools for AI agents: free SKILL.md agent skills, a free MCP server (cygnix-seo-mcp), pay-per-event Apify actors (username cygnix_labs, callable via https://mcp.apify.com), and full skills on Agensi. Updated 2026-10-27.

## Free

- [Free SEO/GEO/AEO agent skills](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/skills/): 6 MIT skills, install with `npx skills add cygnixlabs-cmd/cygnix-seo-skills`
- [Cygnix SEO MCP server](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/mcp/): `npx -y cygnix-seo-mcp`, local keyword clustering, intent, GSC cannibalization, title/meta, content brief

## Apify actors

- [Website SEO Audit & Site Audit Crawler: Technical SEO + AEO/GEO](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/apify/site-seo-aeo-audit.html): SEO audit + site audit crawler with an AEO/GEO (AI search) score and technical SEO checks. One URL in: every page and the site scored 0-100 for meta tags, broken links, soft 404s, schema, llms.txt… Price: $0.01 per page audited.
- [AEO & AI Visibility Audit: LLM SEO, GEO + llms.txt Checker](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/apify/aeo-readiness-checker.html): AEO & GEO audit (answer engine optimization, generative engine optimization, LLM SEO): can ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and AI Overviews cite your pages? 0-100 AI search visibility score per URL… Price: $0.005 per page audited.
- [Keyword Cannibalization Checker for Google Search Console](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/apify/keyword-cannibalization-finder.html): Keyword cannibalization checker for Google Search Console (GSC): paste a query+page export or a Google Sheets/CSV link. Get pages competing for the same keyword, click split, HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW severity… Price: $0.005 per cannibalization issue.
- [Content Decay Audit - Google Search Console Traffic Drop](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/apify/content-decay-audit.html): Content decay audit for Google Search Console: compare Pages exports (CSV, GSC ZIP, Excel or Google Sheets link, any language) and find pages losing traffic. Labels LOST, RANK_SLIP, DECAYING… Price: $0.001 per page analyzed.
- [Keyword Clustering Tool & Grouper + Content Brief Generator](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/apify/keyword-clusterer-brief.html): Keyword clustering & keyword grouping tool: group a keyword list or Ahrefs/Semrush/GSC/Keyword Planner export into topic clusters by shared terms + search intent, build a topical map, get content… Price: $0.0007 per keyword clustered; $0.01 per content brief.
- [SERP Intent Mapper: Keyword Search Intent Classifier](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/apify/serp-intent-mapper.html): Bulk search intent classifier for keyword lists. Labels each keyword informational, commercial, transactional or navigational (+ local, question flags) and names the page type to build. English… Price: $0.0005 per keyword classified.
- [Internal Link Audit: Orphan Pages, Broken Links & Redirects](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/apify/internal-link-audit.html): Internal link audit from your sitemap: orphan pages, weak and broken internal links, internal links to redirects, redirected or noindex sitemap URLs, click depth and anchor text, with a fix per page.… Price: $0.002 per page audited.
- [Tech Stack Detector, Pixel Checker & BuiltWith Alternative](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/apify/website-tech-stack-detector.html): Tech stack detector, pixel checker and BuiltWith / Wappalyzer alternative for lead lists. Paste domains or emails; get CMS, Shopify, GA4, GTM tags, Meta/TikTok/LinkedIn pixels, tracking IDs, consent… Price: $0.0015 per domain analyzed.
- [Email Scraper & Contact Details Scraper: Phones, Socials](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/apify/outreach-contact-finder.html): Email scraper and contact details scraper for websites. Paste domains or URLs (e.g. Google Maps leads) and get emails, phone numbers (incl. WhatsApp), contact/impressum pages and social links… Price: $0.004 per domain with contacts.
- [Best Time to Post: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube & LinkedIn](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/apify/social-best-time-to-post.html): Find the best time to post on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn from real post data or your analytics CSV export: weekday x hour heatmap in your time zone, engagement rate, best format, caption… Price: $0.03 per account report.
- [Hashtag Generator & Finder: Instagram & TikTok Hashtags](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/apify/hashtag-research-strategy.html): Hashtag generator, finder and analytics for Instagram hashtags and TikTok hashtags from real posts: tags creators pair with your seed, real post/view counts, broad/mid/niche tiers, paste-ready 5 and… Price: $0.03 per seed hashtag report.
- [YouTube Channel Analyzer: Analytics & Competitor Analysis](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/apify/youtube-channel-analyzer.html): YouTube channel analyzer for creators and marketers: subscribers, views, upload cadence, best upload day and hour, outlier videos vs channel median, winning title patterns and topics, engagement… Price: $0.025 per channel report.
- [Redirect Checker & Bulk URL Status: Chains, Loops, 301 Map QA](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/apify/redirect-checker.html): Bulk redirect checker and HTTP status code checker. Traces every hop (301/302/307/308, meta refresh) and flags redirect chains, loops, 404s, soft 404s, noindex targets and redirect-map mismatches… Price: $0.0008 per url checked.
- [Brand Facts Checker & Organization Schema Generator (AEO)](https://cygnixlabs-cmd.github.io/cygnix-seo-skills/apify/brand-facts-checker.html): Find brand facts your own site contradicts (founding year, customer counts, phone/email, schema vs page, 404 About page, placeholder sameAs) and get Organization JSON-LD + a citable brand-facts page… Price: $0.009 per site audited.
